svg.title: Pundoku — знак P4 «Девять клеток» — favicon (клетки)
svg.desc: The P4 mark with no ground plate on a 16-unit grid: nine 3x3 cells with 1-unit gaps, every edge on an integer, so at 24, 32, 48 and 64 px edges rasterize with no antialiasing. For 24 px and above; below that use p4-favicon-solid.svg (the same P without gaps). One colour, #5F6DF2 (4.24:1 on a white tab, 4.02:1 on a dark one); deliberately not wrapped in prefers-color-scheme (Safari ignores it inside an SVG favicon). The same cells are what Mark.tsx draws from 24 to 60 px. Generated by design/pd155-icons.mjs.
